descricao_original: This lymphocyte with its distinct heterochromatic, spherical nucleus is located in connective tissue after its migration from the blood. Its morphology would be similar in either location. This lymphocyte has a moderate amount of cytoplasm and, thus, is either a medium lymphocyte or is in the process of transforming into a plasma cell. 7000x
